notes.sowing: Start indoors 4 to 6 weeks before planting out, or sow {cm:1} deep outdoors 1 to 4 weeks before your last frost. For the main fall crop, sow about 12 weeks before your first fall frost.
notes.care: Collards take more heat than most cabbage-family crops, but they grow best and taste sweetest in cool weather. Water deeply in dry spells and avoid ground where cabbage-family crops grew recently.
notes.harvest: Pick leaves from the bottom up while young and tender, a few per plant at a time. Mature plants stand frost and light freezes, and the leaves sweeten after a frost.
